about: Token ids whose ledger exceeds the vault for a reason other than the October incident. They show as 'standing' (not growing) or 'drift' instead of ALARM because the alarm is baseline-aware. Reviewed by hand on 2026-11-04 from scans at blocks 217,500,000 (2026-09-27) and the latest block.

classes.hot_near_native: HOT Omni ids with chain prefix 1010 (NEAR). The part after the underscore base58-decodes to a NEAR account, so the id is a HOT representation of a NEAR-native token. v2_1.omni.hot.tg reports no balance for intents.near on these ids, so their vault cannot be read with this method; the backing would have to be checked at the bridge level.
classes.test_or_staging: Test or staging tokens (names contain 'test' or 'stg'); not user funds.
classes.collectible_mt: Collectible-style multi tokens on mt.nfts.tg with whole-unit amounts (1 or a few units).
classes.dust: A gap that is negligible relative to the ledger (below 1e-30 of it).
